overview_description.description:
Drivezy (formerly JustRide) is India's largest marketplace for car and two-wheeler sharing. Drivezy helps people turn their vehicles into earning members of their family. Through Drivezy, travelers can book scooters, motorcycles and cars from people living around them. 

Since commencing services in April, 2015, Drivezy has connected over 1500 owners to its marketplace. Drivezy is an alum of  Y Combinator's S16 batch and the maiden batch of Google's Launchpad Accelerator.
